notes.title: ☪️ TSUNDERE MILFIN — Update 1.15 is live!
notes.content:
[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2307220/extras/450hader.gif[/img]
[b]🆕 Update 1.15 is now available in-game![/b]

A fresh update has just been released for our beloved office sim — check it out now! 

Version 1.15 adds a brand [b]new situation[/b] on the map that brings even more intrigue to your workdays. You’ll also find [b]2 fully animated scenes[/b] and 1 minigame waiting for you. 🔥 ːfuhrer_heartː

To access the new content, you’ll need the Strange Coin. 🪙
What happens if you use it? Who knows… but HR is already watching. 😳

Just one rule:
NO RUNNING ON THE STAIRS!
(Seriously. We’re running out of warning signs.) 💦

Thanks a lot for playing and sticking with us 💖
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2307220/TSUNDERE_MILFIN/

Your feedback has been incredibly helpful along the way.
[b]Discord: [/b]https://discord.gg/XXhvfX8RQt
[b]Telegram: [/b]https://t.me/CUTEANIMEDE 

[b]Check our X/Twitter for more news:[/b]
[url=https://twitter.com/CUTEANIMEDEV]
[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2649320/extras/twitter.png[/img][/url]

Thank you so much for supporting — we really appreciate every message, idea, and wishlisted page!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2649320/Timeless_Cafe/

notes.title: ⨁My Cute Pagangirl⨁ Halloween update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40627901/f3e291f468ee998675738512fda23bf4b63c8ee9.png[/img]

[h1][b]:orange_heart:New Halloween levels!:orange_heart:[/b][/h1]

[b]Kittens [/b], we released a small update. We fixed old bugs, tightened up optimization and added several [b] special Halloween levels[/b] with [b]Baba Yaga[/b]. Just click on the Halloween 2021 button in the main menu and enjoy! :fuhrer_loving:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40627901/1fef3526bf3ff1cf4aefabb923b6c33927f1570d.png[/img]

[h3]Don't miss our new game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1719660/My_Cute_Succubus/][b]✟My Cute Succubus✟[/b][/url]![/h3]
It is even more interesting, prettier, and generally just cool. We personally really like it, I hope you will like it too!:fuhrer_heart:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1719660/My_Cute_Succubus/
